style: Bad MS Paint doodle drawn by someone with no drawing skill, deliberately crude, clumsy and funny. Plain white background. Thick uneven wobbly black marker outlines. Stick figures with round heads, dot eyes, simple line mouths, straight stick limbs. Every stick figure has exactly one head, two arms and two legs, and every line is connected to the body. Flat solid color fills only, no shading, no gradients, no texture, no text, no letters, no words, no numbers. Vertical portrait composition.
rurik: a small doodle sphynx cat named Rurik: hairless with pale pink skin, wrinkly, huge pointy ears, big round eyes, skinny tail (the only colored thing in the picture)
pureum: a round fluffy grey doodle cat
